Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Initial commit: External File Links plugin with configurable drop behavior

Obsidian plugin that creates ext:// links to external files via drag and drop.

Features:
- Configurable default drop action \(external link vs import to vault\)
- Modifier key \(Shift/Ctrl/Meta\) to toggle alternate drop behavior
- Alt/Option toggles between embed and link style
- Support for images, videos, audio, PDFs with inline previews
- Configurable max image width and PDF height
- Missing file placeholder option

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")
